fair_value_reason: Agent blends $6.8-9.6 (mean $8.08). Reconciled facts applied to each: Justified capex to go $4.26B (PSC release: $4.0-4.5B covers site development and halls, not the $200M land; $353M contributed incl. land), Justified put ~$150M paid ~end-2028 (PV ~$0.13B), Chesapeake $175M x 85% less ~$65M plant value, and agent_4's unbacked Fluidstack rent moved from 8.5% to ~9.5%. Corrected blends: agent_1 $7.63, agent_2 $7.10, agent_3 $8.68, agent_4 $9.81, agent_5 $6.64; mean $7.97. The agents now use split rates themselves, so the round-3 asset-rate uplift (+$0.75-0.9) is no longer added. ~$8.0, down from $9.5 in round 3 and ~46% below $14.91.

thesis_triggers.event: Forecaster breaks are $5.0-7.0 (mean $5.85). Contracted-only split-rate values are ~$4.5-6.3 for four agents ($2.5 for agent_5 after SBC). A sustained close near $6 means the market gives the pipeline nothing and doubts the contracts or financing: a punitive or failed ~$3.5B Justified financing, loss of Anthropic's expected IG support, CB-4/CB-5 commencement slipping far enough to delay the Google backstop tranches, or a dilutive raise.

supervisor_summary: Round 4 forced every site into each model once and split the discount rate. All five now carry the 438 MW Lake Mariner leases, Justified, mining, four pipeline sites and the Abernathy sale proceeds correctly, with no MW counted twice and no pipeline counted twice within a blend. Remaining errors are small and fixed here: Justified capex to go (~$4.26B), one assumption each for the undisclosed seller put (~$150M) and Chesapeake price ($175M), and agent_4's backstopped rate on unbacked rent. Reconciled split-rate DCFs are $5.4-9.0 (mean $6.7) against $4.0-8.5 single-rate (mean $5.8). Blends average ~$8.0 against a $14.91 spot, so the ladder stays at the forecasters' mean (P(>= spot) 0.39); pipeline value is now the widest disagreement.
key_drivers: Pipeline value is now the widest disagreement ($0.1-3.0/share across agents): yield on cost (deck 'low-teens' vs call 'mid-teens'), tenant odds at Muskie and Chesapeake, and NY permitting (EO 62, Lansing draft ban)
Discount rate: the split adds ~$0.7-1.4/share over single-rate DCFs; WACC (10-11%) on post-term, terminal and pipeline flows still moves value ~$1.5-2/share per 50-100bp
Justified (401 MW, $19B/20 yrs): unpriced ~$3.5B leveraged-loan/HY financing, Anthropic IG support still 'expected'; ~$4.26B capex to go
CB-4/CB-5 commencement: no confirmation as of Oct 2; each Google backstop tranche ($1.8B CB-3/CB-4, $1.4B CB-5) takes effect only at commencement
Bridge: $5.725B face debt, ~$3.03B cash at 6/30 less $295M Muskie collateral, $530M Abernathy proceeds, ~613M diluted shares; corporate cash G&A ~$140M/yr plus SBC
